title: Will 2026 to 2030 average more than 1.5 °C of warming?
who: World Meteorological Organization, Global Annual to Decadal Climate Update
forecast: A 75% chance that the five-year average will be more than 1.5 °C above 1850 to 1900
note: A five-year average above 1.5 °C would not by itself break the Paris limit, which refers to warming averaged over decades. The 2025 edition gave a 70% chance for 2025 to 2029.
source: WMO Global Annual to Decadal Climate Update (28 May 2026)

title: Share of people in extreme poverty in 2030
who: United Nations, Sustainable Development Goals Report
forecast: About 9% of the world's population on the current path
note: Measured against the World Bank's $3-a-day line. The goal is to end extreme poverty by 2030; this is where current trends point. The 2025 report said 8.9%.
source: UN Sustainable Development Goals Report 2026, Goal 1

title: People facing hunger in 2030
who: FAO, IFAD, UNICEF, WFP and WHO, The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World
forecast: 510 to 520 million people on current trends
note: The goal is zero hunger by 2030. EarthOS tracks hunger as a share of the population, so the live figure is in a different unit.
source: FAO and partners, The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World 2026

title: People without electricity in 2030
who: Tracking SDG7: The Energy Progress Report (IEA, IRENA, UN, World Bank and WHO)
forecast: At least 644 million people on current trends
note: The goal is electricity for everyone by 2030. EarthOS tracks the share of people with access, so the live figure is in a different unit.
source: Tracking SDG7: The Energy Progress Report 2026, via Sustainable Energy for All

title: Share of people with clean cooking in 2030
who: Tracking SDG7: The Energy Progress Report (IEA, IRENA, UN, World Bank and WHO)
forecast: 79% of the world's population on current trends (range 74% to 81%)
note: The goal is clean cooking for everyone by 2030. That would leave about 1.8 billion people without it. The 2025 report projected 78%.
source: Tracking SDG7: The Energy Progress Report 2026, chapter 2
